---
title: "Color Plot for figures"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
```

```{r parents}
## specify order
levels_parent <- c("paired mother", "single mother", "paired father",  "single father" )

## pick colors using http://colorbrewer2.org/
colors_parent <- c("paired mother" = "#f7f7f7", 
               "single mother" = "#f0f0f0", 
               "paired father" = "#d9d9d9",
               "single father" = "#bdbdbd")
```

```{r parents pooling}
## specify order
levels_parent_pool <- c("paired parent","single parent" )

## pick colors using http://colorbrewer2.org/
colors_parent_pool <- c("paired parent" = "#969696", 
               "single parent" = "#737373")
```

```{r parents cumulative time- mainly for behavior}
## specify order
levels_parent_cumm <- c("paired","single mother", "single father" )

## pick colors using http://colorbrewer2.org/
colors_parent_cumm <- c("paired parents" = "#969696", 
               "single mother" = "#f0f0f0",
               "single father" = "#bdbdbd")
```
```{r cumulative time - parents pooling by nest type}
## specify order
levels_parent_cpool <- c("paired parents","single parent" )

## pick colors using http://colorbrewer2.org/
colors_parent_cpool <- c("paired parents" = "#969696", 
               "single parent" = "#737373")
```
```{r chicks}
## specify order
levels_chick <- c("paired parents", "single mother","single father" )

## pick colors using http://colorbrewer2.org/
colors_chick <- c("paired parents" = "#969696", 
               "single mother" = "#f0f0f0", 
               "single father" = "#bdbdbd")
```

```{r chicks pooling}
## specify order
levels_chick_pool <- c("paired parents", "single parent" )

## pick colors using http://colorbrewer2.org/
colors_chick_pool <- c("paired parents" = "#969696", 
               "single parent" = "#737373")
```
